# Best home backup power station under $1,000

**My pick: BLUETTI Elite 200 V2, about $899.** It has 2,073.6 Wh of LiFePO4 battery, 2,600 W output and a 6,000+ cycle rating. That's roughly 1.6 days for a fridge, or about 23 hours for a fridge, CPAP and router together. It also has a UPS switchover of 15 ms or less.
- Buy: https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-200-v2 (affiliate link). Dealectric lists $854.05 with code AFF5OFF, last tested Oct 24.
- Sources: [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/answers/best-home-backup-power-stations-under-1000-2026-reviews-price-battery-capacity), [Outage Outfitter](https://outageoutfitter.com/best/under-1000/)

**Check the price before you buy.** Outage Authority reported on Oct 7 that Bluetti ended a promotion and the Elite 200 V2 was back at $1,199 on Bluetti's store, though Amazon had it at $798.99 that day ([source](https://outageauthority.com/roundups/best-power-station-home-backup)). Three other sources, updated Oct 19-24, list it at $899. If it's over $1,000 at checkout, go with the Anker below. The Elite 200 V2 also can't be expanded.

## Other good options

- **Anker SOLIX C2000 Gen 2, about $899.99:** This is the pick if you want to add capacity later. It has 2,048 Wh and 2,400 W output, and a BP2000 battery pack can double it to 4 kWh. It also has a 10 ms UPS switchover and a TT-30 RV outlet. I didn't get a direct buy link in the results. Details are in [Outage Authority's roundup](https://outageauthority.com/roundups/best-power-station-home-backup), and the [Compare Power Stations ranking](https://comparepowerstations.com/best/best-under-1000/) lists it at $899.99.
- **BLUETTI AC200L, $899:** It's also expandable, from 2,048 Wh up to 8,192 Wh, but its cycle rating is lower at 3,000+. Buy: https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac200l (affiliate link)
- **BLUETTI AC180, $499:** This is the budget capacity pick, with 1,152 Wh and 1,800 W. It runs a fridge, CPAP and router for about 13 hours. It's heavier at 35.3 lb and has no expansion port. Buy: https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac180 (affiliate link)
- **Jackery Explorer 1000 v2, $489 at Outbound Power:** It's the lightest at 23.8 lb, with 1,070 Wh and 1,500 W output. That's about 12 hours of fridge, CPAP and router. Jackery's own store raised its price to $559, so the $489 is a third-party price. I don't have a direct link, but the [review](https://outageauthority.com/reviews/jackery-explorer-1000-v2) covers it.

## Which to choose
- **Outages of a day or two:** the Elite 200 V2 if the price holds at $899 or less, otherwise the Anker C2000 Gen 2.
- **Wanting to grow the system later:** the Anker C2000 Gen 2.
- **Overnight outages on a tight budget:** the AC180 or Jackery 1000 v2.

Most of these sites earn commissions through their links, and the runtime figures are estimates from manufacturer specs, not independent tests. Prices change often, so confirm the final price at checkout.
